rates.title: Qiyaasta Heerarka Is-weydaarsiga
rates.subtitle: Ka hubi heerarka waqtiga-dhabta ah oo qiyaas khidmadaha macaamilka.
rates.loadingMethods: Hababka bixinta ayaa la soo dejinayaa...
rates.verifyToContinue: Xaqiiji akoonka si aad u sii wadato
rates.netAmount: Qadarka saafiga ah ee la wareejinayo
rates.amountIncludingFees: Qadarka oo ay ku jiraan khidmadaha
rates.disclaimer: Tani waa qiime qiyaas ah oo ku saleysan heerarka suuqa ee hadda jira. Qiimaha kama dambaysta ah waxaa la xaqiijin doonaa marka aan helno lacagta.
rates.feeInfo: Macaamilladu waxay ku xiran yihiin komishan, xogta kor ku xusan ayaa muujinaysa heerarka.
rates.alert.estimate: Tani waa qiime kaliya oo qiyaas ah oo ku saleysan qiimaha suuqa. Waxaan xaqiijin doonnaa qiimaha marka lacagta nala soo gaarsiiyo.
rates.pasteAccountAddressPlaceholder: Halkan ku dheji ciwaanka koontadaada bangiga
rates.confirmAddress: Waxaan xaqiijinayaa in ciwaanka koontada bangiga uu sax yahay.
rates.termsOwnAccount: Fadlan lacagta ka soo dir koontadaada oo kaliya
rates.termsTransactionId: Geli aqoonsiga macaamilka (Transaction ID) qaybta sharaxaadda ee bangiga
rates.termsReject: Fadlan ogow, haddii aadan raacin shuruudaha kore, waan diidi doonaa macaamilkaaga waxaanuna kuu soo celin doonaa lacagtaada.
rates.noteInstructions: Fadlan koodhkan macaamilka ku qor fariinta bangiga ama qaybta qoraalka.
rates.noteAccuracy: Tani waxay naga caawinaysaa inaan macaamilkaaga u socodsiino si dhakhso ah oo sax ah.
rates.amountTooLargeInput: Qadarkan waa mid aad u weyn si sax ah loo xisaabiyo. Geli qadar ka yar.
rates.swapEstimateUnavailable: Ma heli karno qiimaha tan qadarkan. Isku day qadar ka yar ama dib u isku day.
